column1: P-SITE, not read 5' end. Pack targets come from RiboCode process_bam after applying the metaplots-derived per-read-length offset.
column2: start: first nt of the start codon (A of AUG). stop: first nt of the stop codon.
column3: transcript (not genomic); no splicing correction needed
column4: annotated CDS AND has_start_codon == 1 in data/tx2cds.tsv
column5: yes -- a transcript contributes to an offset only if that offset exists in it. Divide psites by the per-row n_tx, never by a global count, or the window edges decay for the wrong reason.
column6: each transcript scaled to sum 1 within its own window before pooling; removes the dominance of highly translated genes that `psites` has
